title: there’s no point in -ing, it’s worth -ing etc.

leftOptions: It’s no use standing here talking.
There’s no point in looking for him.
It’s no good apologising to me.
It’s not worth arguing with him.
The hotel is a short walk from here.
rightOptions: It’s not worth getting a taxi.
It’s worth spending a few days here.

exercises.instruction: Write sentences beginning There’s no point … .

items.prompt: Why work if you don’t need money?
answers: There’s no point in working if you don’t need money.

items.prompt: Don’t try to study if you feel tired.
answers: There’s no point in trying to study if you feel tired.
There’s no point in studying if you feel tired.

items.prompt: Why hurry if you have plenty of time?
answers: There’s no point in hurrying if you have plenty of time.
